tenseOptions.label: Present
tenseOptions.title: Present (presente)
tenseOptions.description: Current or habitual actions: parlo = I speak / I am speaking.

tenseOptions.label: Passato prossimo
tenseOptions.title: Passato prossimo (present perfect)
tenseOptions.description: Completed actions: avere or essere + past participle. With essere the participle agrees with the subject (andato / andata).

tenseOptions.label: Imperfect
tenseOptions.title: Imperfetto (imperfect)
tenseOptions.description: Ongoing or habitual past actions: parlavo = I was speaking / I used to speak.

tenseOptions.label: Future
tenseOptions.title: Futuro semplice (future)
tenseOptions.description: Future actions: parlerò = I will speak.

tenseOptions.label: Conditional
tenseOptions.title: Condizionale presente (conditional)
tenseOptions.description: Polite requests and hypotheticals: vorrei = I would like.

functions.label: Ability / permission
functions.description: Can, cannot, may: potere (posso, puoi), sapere for a learned skill (so nuotare), riuscire a for managing to do something.

functions.label: Necessity / need
functions.description: Have to and need to: dovere (devo, dobbiamo) or avere bisogno di.

functions.label: Desire / wish
functions.description: Want, would like, hope: volere (voglio), the conditional vorrei / mi piacerebbe, desiderare, sperare di.

functions.label: Used to / was
functions.description: Ongoing or habitual past in the imperfetto: ero, avevo, abitavo, facevo.

functions.label: Future plans
functions.description: Plans and intentions: the futuro (andrò, farò) or avere intenzione di.

functions.label: Likes / preferences
functions.description: Likes and preferences: mi piace / mi piacciono, preferire.

sentenceTypes.label: Negative
sentenceTypes.description: A sentence with non or nessuno.

sentenceTypes.label: Request / command
sentenceTypes.description: Asks or tells someone to do something, or orders (Vorrei..., Giri a destra).
